metadataPrimary.text: Today, on Father's Day, I'm thinking about how my dad immigrated to the United States after escaping three civil wars and working as a janitor, only to see his bloodline die out because his son stumbled into a menswear forum and then spent the next 20 years arguing about pants with teenagers named Pablo Thriftscobar.

renderedTextCandidates.text: Lucky dad, at Least his son didn’t become maga

I lol so much over these stories from children of immigrants bringing ridicule to their hardworking ancestors, but also...YEA, this is why they came here. So you have the chance to argue with Pablo Thriftscobar about pants - and bring a lot of joy to people while doing it. (I say this a child of an immigrant raised in refugee camps, as I sit here wasting the potential my grandparents worked so hard for)
Pablo Thriftscobar" is a name I did not need but absolutely deserved

The reports coming out of Walter Reed regarding Donald Trump’s blood treatment today are… unexpected, to say the least. It’s less about the procedure and more about the specific advice his doctor reportedly gave him. Moments like this make you stop and think. I am thinking of his family and everyone affected by this news as they go through this difficult time. 1/2
Progeny is temporary. Style is forever.
Oh Pablo is such a troll 🧌😡
Not to diminish your success on social media, it is well deserved. But with regards to pants, Pablo was right.
Cmon. I’m sure you argue about other things as well.
Pablo Thriftscobar also sounds like the end of a bloodline.
You had to be that Guy
